risks.title: Network Infrastructure Dependency
risks.score_rationale: Comcast operates hybrid fiber-optic and coaxial (HFC) networks and depends on third-party telecommunications providers internationally; network quality and availability are critical to service delivery (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: The company is exposed to risks related to network availability, capacity constraints, and obsolescence as technology evolves

risks.title: Competitive Intensity
risks.score_rationale: Telecommunications and media distribution markets are highly competitive with established players and emerging digital platforms (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Intense competition in broadband, wireless, video, and streaming segments threatens market share and pricing power

risks.title: Regulatory and Compliance
risks.score_rationale: Comcast operates under extensive telecommunications, media, and consumer protection regulations that vary by jurisdiction (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Evolving regulations on net neutrality, content, privacy, and international operations may impact business flexibility and profitability

risks.title: Cybersecurity and Data Protection
risks.score_rationale: As a connectivity and media company, Comcast manages significant customer data, network infrastructure and intellectual property exposed to sophisticated cyber threats (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Increased cyber threats including ransomware, data breaches, and DDoS attacks pose risks to customer trust, regulatory compliance, and operational continuity

risks.title: Technology Obsolescence
risks.score_rationale: Rapid technology evolution requires continuous capital investment in network upgrades and platform modernization (e.g., fiber deployment, cloud-based services) (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Failure to invest adequately in emerging technologies could lead to competitive disadvantage and service quality deterioration

risks.title: Third-party Partnership Risks
risks.score_rationale: Comcast relies on partnerships with network providers (Verizon for wireless MVNO), content distributors, and technology vendors for service delivery (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Dependence on partner reliability, quality of service, and contractual terms creates operational and financial risks

company_description: Comcast Corporation operates as a media and technology company worldwide. The company operates through Residential Connectivity & Platforms, Business Services Connectivity, Media, Studios, and Theme Parks segments. Its Residential Connectivity & Platforms segment provides residential broadband and wireless connectivity services, residential and business video services, sky-branded entertainment television networks, and advertising. The Business Services Connectivity segment offers connectivity services for small business locations, which include broadband, wireline voice, and wireless services; and ethernet network services for medium-sized customers and larger enterprises. Its Media segment operates NBCUniversal's national and regional cable networks; the NBC and Telemundo broadcast networks and owned local broadcast television stations; and Peacock, a direct-to-consumer streaming services. The company also operates international television networks comprising the Sky Sports networks, as well as other digital properties.
